CIPIT states that Kenya currently has no AI laws, with AI regulated mainly through the Data Protection Act (2019) and supplementary policies such as the National AI Strategy; dated by its publication date.
CIPIT states that Kenya is in the process of drafting an AI Bill, 2026, whose main objective is a framework for the regulation and governance of AI; dated by its publication date.
